observations: Requester has the required change_approver role, so rejection exercises separation of duties rather than a missing-role check.
Self-approval raises ForbiddenError; persisted request remains pending without approver, decision timestamp or application timestamp.
Target remains pending; no successful access_request.decided event is emitted for the rejected attempt.
Administrator cannot apply the still-pending request.
Separate approver can approve the same request; subsequent administrator application activates the target.
limitations: Temporary synthetic SQLite database; service-level test only. HTTP authorization and MFA are not exercised.
Historical joiner approvals, first activation timestamps and approved role-matrix reconciliation remain unverified.
